server.name: community-allyotter
server.version: allyotter-lite (PyPI, uvx latest at image build time)
server.note: Drawn in frame order from block 3 of Frame 3. Seven tools declaring no annotations at all. It keeps a submissions file under HOME, so HOME moves into the trial root, and it offers a read tool that lists the file back.
server.note_projection: The store is one JSON document and every write stamps it, so a clean baseline never reproduces it verbatim. Two keys are dropped (preregistration 6.3): `updated` on the record and `at` on each history entry, both wall clock. Nothing else is: in particular each history entry keeps its `status`, and lists keep their length and order, so a repeat that appends a second history entry still shows even though every surviving field in it is identical to the first. That is the measurement here, because the record itself is keyed and a repeat upserts it.
server.note_lock: A lock file sits beside the store and is not matched by the pattern, so it is neither compared nor mistaken for state.

fixtures.note: The record is keyed by network and product, so the record itself is an upsert, while the history inside it is append-only. The two halves of one write disagree about repeat safety, which is why the projection keeps list lengths: a caller reading the record back sees one submission either way, and the history is where a repeat is visible. `probe_drop_keys` is declared because the read tool returns a changing `updated` stamp: S1 and S2 are separate trials at different times, so without the declaration a moving clock would be read as a visible duplicate.
